title: Check a good before it goes on sale
tagline: Stores & Skills: read everything, then approve or turn it down
transcript: How to check a good before buyers can see it.
Open Stores & Skills.
Look at the photos: they must show the real good.
Read the details. Do they make sense for this good and this price?
If all is right, tap Approve. If not, Turn down with a reason.

title: Check a held Market listing
tagline: Market → To check: approve it, or take it down
transcript: How to check a Market listing held by the safety checks.
Open Market.
Tap To check.
Read why it was held, the description and the details.
Tap Approve, or Take it down. A seller who breaks the rules can be stopped.

title: Approve new people
tagline: User Approvals: check each new sign-up
transcript: How to approve people who signed up.
Open User Approvals.
Check the person, then Approve or Reject.

title: System Check
tagline: Green, orange or red for each part of Trothen
transcript: How to check that Trothen is working.
Open System Check.
Tap Check now.
Each part shows green, orange or red, with the likely cause and what to do.
Tap Copy report to send it to whoever fixes it.

title: Ride and delivery fares
tagline: Admin → Rides: the L$ fares for each vehicle
transcript: How to set the L$ fares for rides and deliveries.
Open Rides.
Choose the country. Each vehicle has a starting price, a price per km and a minimum.
Type today's fuel price: fares move with it once the change passes your limit.
